blockers: PLAN INVALIDATED: ExistPart_r (generalized exist part with r parent NFs) is provably FALSE on Prior structures. Counterexample in NfComposition.lean:20-36: on (Z, <), pairs (0,2) and (0,1) have identical arity-1 NFs and matching orders but different arity-2 NFs. The zone interior structure (elements between the two points) differs, and this is NOT captured by individual NF types.

CONSTANT-PARENT GAP: ih_exist uses env (fun _ => t), which only expresses [y, t, t, ...]. The Until zone needs [y, x, t] with distinct x, t. No instantiation of ih_exist can produce non-constant environments.

DEPTH GAP: nf_extend_fwd loses one depth level per arity increase. To transfer depth-(k'+2) arity-2 NFs requires depth-(k'+2) arity-2 agreement as input — circular. The gap is systematic and unavoidable via nf_extend_fwd.

continuation_context.approach_invalidated: ExistPart_r AND NfCompose — both provably false on Prior structures
continuation_context.recommended_approach: Zone-explicit temporal formula encoding (Rabinovich Section 5): decompose quantifier conditions exists y, nf_eval [y, x, t] ssn by y's position relative to x and t (5 zones). Encode each zone as nested Until/Since with ih_exist at constant parent. E.g., Zone 'y > x': from x, Until(type_formula, top). Zone 't < y < x': from x, Since(type_formula, char_kp1(nf_t)).
alternative_approaches: Ordered sum decomposition via NEquivalence CompData infrastructure
Direct induction on formula quantifier rank (formula-level Kamp's theorem)
Weaken goal via CharPart-only completeness path
